video_caption: The video begins with a news-style lower third graphic displaying "EAGLE NEWS" with a red and gray geometric pattern and a world map. Above the graphic, a digitally rendered scene shows a close-up of a bald eagle's head looking to the right, set against a vibrant orange and yellow sunset or sunrise. In the background, two smaller, dark birds soar across the sky, with a barren tree on the right and a rocky formation with a cavity on the left. This scene briefly darkens and then brightens again before transitioning to a deep space image of a nebula. This nebula features a prominent bright red star with radiating light at its core, surrounded by swirling clouds of brownish and purplish cosmic dust, dotted with several bright blue-white stars that also exhibit a cross-like light effect. A male voice begins narrating about the existence of Nibiru. The scene then transitions to a view of Earth's atmosphere from space, showing a thin blue band of light against the dark void, which gradually gives way to a vast, dark expanse filled with countless white stars, as the narration continues about the search for a hidden planet.

The video segment opens with a shot of a dark night sky filled with countless tiny white specks, representing stars, against a deep blue-black background. The stars appear to shimmer slightly, with some brighter than others. The camera slowly pans across this celestial view, giving the impression of moving through space. The lighting is dim, highlighting the bright pinpricks of light from the stars. There are no people or discernible objects other than the stars themselves. The overall setting is outer space, creating a mysterious and vast atmosphere as a male voice discusses ancient and modern evidence for the existence of another planet.

The video segment opens with an animated diagram illustrating several elliptical orbits of celestial objects, labeled with names like "2013 RF98," "2004 VN112," "2012 VP113," and "2010 GB174," around the orbits of "Saturn," "Uranus," and "Neptune." This transitions to a simplified animation showing two concentric orbital paths with smaller blue celestial bodies and dotted lines labeled "a" and "b" indicating interactions, with a glowing yellow sun-like object in the bottom right. The scene then shifts to a more complex, dense star chart with vertical labels for "Saturn," "Uranus," and "Neptune" on the left, and clusters of red and blue dots, along with labels for "Kuiper Belt," "Scattered disk," "Pluto," and "Eris." At the bottom, the text "Trans-Neptunian objects" is displayed. This detailed chart then fades into a black and white photograph of a man with a mustache, wearing a suit and tie, sitting in a chair. The next shot shows the same man, now superimposed over an observatory setting, seated and looking through a large, angled telescope. Finally, this image transitions to a full animated diagram of the solar system, featuring the "Sun" at the center, surrounded by concentric orbits of "Mercury," "Venus," "Earth," "Mars," the "Asteroid belt," "Jupiter," "Saturn," "Uranus," and "Neptune," all depicted as colored spheres. A red text banner appears at the bottom left, stating "SUBSCRIBE."

The video opens with a black and white shot of a man in a suit, seen in profile, looking intently into the eyepiece of a large, complex scientific instrument, possibly an early telescope or camera, while adjusting its controls with his right hand. A red "SUBSCRIBE" text is visible at the bottom left. The scene then transitions to a full-color, detailed image of Pluto, a spherical celestial body with patches of white, light brown, and reddish-brown, set against a black, starless background. The "SUBSCRIBE" text remains. Next, the screen displays a wider view of the Kuiper Belt, showing Pluto (with its moon Charon, Hydra, and Nix) alongside several other dwarf planets and trans-Neptunian objects like Haumea, Makemake, Eris, Sedna, Orcus, Ixion, Varuna, Quaoar, and Weywot, all rendered as spheres of varying sizes and colors against the blackness of space, with the label "Kuiper Belt" at the top. The "SUBSCRIBE" text is still present. The view then shifts to a dark, red-hued star field, filled with numerous small, bright white and reddish-orange dots. Three of these dots are highlighted with white circles around them, suggesting objects of interest. Finally, a large, dark, spherical celestial body with a faintly illuminated edge appears in the center-left of the star field, partially obscuring some of the distant dots, while the three circled dots remain visible in the background, along with the "SUBSCRIBE" text.

The video segment opens with a dark, spherical planet-like object, possibly a celestial body, featuring subtle lighter cloud-like patterns on its surface, set against a backdrop of a vast, starry cosmic environment with faint nebulae. A bright, yellowish light, likely a star or the sun, emanates from behind the planet on its right side, illuminating a crescent portion of its surface. In the bottom left corner, a red banner displays the white text "SUBSCRIBE," accompanied by a small red bell icon on its right. At 00:04, the scene transitions to a white diagram on a black background, depicting a simplified solar system model. A yellow circle labeled "Sun" occupies the center, surrounded by two concentric circular orbits. A small blue circle labeled "Earth" is on the inner orbit, with the text "1 AU" indicating its distance from the Sun. A red circle labeled "Mars" is on the outer orbit, with "1.52 AU" marking its distance. A line extends from the Sun to Mars, visually representing this distance. The "SUBSCRIBE" banner remains visible in the bottom left.

The video segment features a four-panel display of ancient reliefs or artifacts. The top-left panel, in a golden hue, shows several figures, one seated and others standing, beneath celestial symbols including a sun-like disk and stars, with these elements highlighted by red, purple, and green circles. The top-right panel is a grayscale relief with a similar composition of figures and celestial symbols, also accentuated by red, purple, and green circles. The bottom-left panel, with an earthy tone, depicts an ornate circular design and star-like shapes, with some parts outlined in green and purple circles. The bottom-right panel, in grayscale, displays more figures and symbols, including a large winged motif circled in red, and other elements in purple and green circles. At the bottom of the screen, the word "SUBSCRIBE" is visible in red text, accompanied by a small red bar.

The video segment displays a collage of images related to the prophet Carlos Muñoz Ferrada and his predictions. On the top left, a black and white photo shows Carlos Muñoz Ferrada sitting at a desk, looking to his right. In the center, a newspaper clipping features a prominent headline in Spanish: "Planeta será visible en agosto en 1999" (Planet will be visible in August in 1999), along with columns of text and a circular diagram, possibly an astronomical chart. Below this, a black and white photo depicts a scene of devastation, with collapsed buildings and debris, and a person walking through it. On the bottom right, a greenish-tinted photo of Carlos Muñoz Ferrada shows him holding a phone to his ear. The scene then transitions to a close-up shot of a hand pointing at a complex handwritten diagram with various lines and circles, resembling an astronomical chart or a correlation map. This is followed by an animated depiction of a solar system against a dark, starry background. A bright central sun is orbited by several planets, and a large, reddish, fiery "comet planet" with a distinct elliptical red trajectory is shown approaching and passing through the system. A red "SUBSCRIBE" button is visible in the bottom left corner throughout most of the segment.

The video segment opens with an animated depiction of a solar system or galaxy, featuring a bright central star and several planets orbiting it on elliptical paths, highlighted in yellow, blue, and red. A prominent red, irregularly shaped celestial body, possibly a comet or another star, is visible on the left, emitting red rays or orbital paths that intersect the system. Below this cosmic scene, a red box with white text reads "SUBSCRIBE" on the left, and a small, colorful icon is present on the right. At 00:06, the scene abruptly transitions to a static, green-tinted close-up image of an older man with dark hair, wearing a suit and tie, holding a black telephone to his ear and looking down thoughtfully.

The video segment opens with a green-tinted vintage-style image of a middle-aged man with dark hair and a mustache, wearing a collared shirt, holding a telephone receiver to his left ear, with a focused expression. This image transitions to a close-up of a green-tinted newspaper clipping from "The Washington Post" with the prominent headline "Possibly as Large as Jupiter" and "Mystery Heavenly Body Discovered," attributed to Thomas O'Toole, detailing the discovery of a heavenly body by an orbiting infrared telescope IRAS. Following this, an animated depiction of a solar system appears, featuring a bright central sun, several planets orbiting in concentric circles, and a distinct reddish-orange planet with an elongated, elliptical orbit highlighted by a red path, suggesting a rogue or highly eccentric celestial body traversing the system. The background is a dark, star-filled cosmic setting. The scene then quickly fades to a dark, silhouetted landscape with what resembles palm or Joshua trees against a dim, greenish-grey sky, after which a light grey rectangular box appears centrally, containing a large blue number "3" with a small yellow element near its base. Throughout the entire segment, the word "SUBSCRIBE" is displayed in red text at the bottom left corner of the screen.

The video segment opens with a dramatic CGI animation of a catastrophic event, showing Earth partially obscured by a smaller, rocky celestial body (resembling the Moon) that is enveloped in a bright, swirling ring of orange and yellow fire and smoke. The background is a dark, star-filled space. This scene quickly transitions to a view of Earth rotating slowly in space, showcasing its blue oceans, white clouds, and discernible green and brown landmasses. As the Earth continues its rotation, the illuminated day side gradually gives way to the darkened night side, where scattered clusters of artificial lights twinkle brightly against the blackness, suggesting human habitation. The cosmic background is a vast expanse of stars and faint nebulae. In the bottom left corner of the screen, the word "SUBSCRIBE" is prominently displayed in red capital letters with a white outline.

The video segment begins with a dark background featuring a light purple square in the center, inside which is a green square containing the purple number "3." Below this, the word "SUBSCRIBE" is displayed in red letters at the bottom left. The scene then quickly transitions to a dark, expansive space environment dotted with many small, bright white stars and faint nebulous light. A large, dense cluster of irregularly shaped, dark grey asteroids appears, brightly illuminated by a prominent white light source on the right side of the frame. The camera continues to pan and zoom, revealing a larger, spherical celestial body, possibly a planet or a very large asteroid, partially obscured by the numerous smaller asteroids that seem to be orbiting or tumbling around it. The overall impression is a bustling asteroid belt, with the "SUBSCRIBE" text remaining visible in the lower left corner throughout these cosmic views.

The video opens with a CGI animation of countless asteroids floating and swirling in dark outer space, with faint nebulae and distant stars visible in the background. A red "SUBSCRIBE" button is present in the bottom left corner, and a small, multicolored icon is in the bottom right. The scene then transitions to a diagram of the inner solar system, showing the Sun at the center, surrounded by concentric blue orbital lines for Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars. A dense, wide band of white dots, representing asteroids, fills the space between Mars and Jupiter's larger blue orbital line. Further out, groups of asteroids are labeled "Trojans" (green dots) and "Hildas" (white dots). The text labels on the diagram include "Sun," "Mercury," "Venus," "Earth," "Mars," "Jupiter," "Trojans," and "Hildas." The red "SUBSCRIBE" button and the small icon persist in the bottom corners.

The video opens with a static shot of an ancient grey relief sculpture depicting three humanoid figures, a central bearded figure wearing a horned headdress holding hands with two winged figures who also wear headdresses. Above them are various symbols including a seven-pointed star, eight circular objects, and two bell-shaped items. This transitions to an animation of a blue-green planet in the foreground, with a bright celestial body in the distant center illuminating an asteroid belt or debris field in space. Following this, an older man with white hair, a mustache, and glasses, wearing a light blue and white striped shirt, is shown indoors holding up a large, elongated grey relief sculpture, similar in style to the opening image. He smiles faintly. The scene then shifts to a close-up of a brownish, irregular clay tablet covered densely with cuneiform script. The video concludes with a black-and-white diagram illustrating a solar system with a central sun, labeled orbits for a "TWELFTH PLANET (Marduk)," "EARTH (Ki)," and "MOON (Kingu)," and an "ASTEROID BELT (Hammered Bracelet)," with arrows indicating directions and paths labeled "TIAMAT'S PATHS: ORIGINAL" and "AFTER COLLISION," along with "NORTH WIND" and "COMETS." Throughout the video, the word "SUBSCRIBE" in red capital letters is visible in the bottom left corner.

The video segment displays a black and white diagram illustrating a celestial event. In the center, a large white circle represents a planet following an orbit labeled "ORBIT OF TWELFTH PLANET (Marduk)". To its right, a scattered band of dots is labeled "ASTEROID BELT (Hammered Bracelet)". Further right and slightly below, a half-circle representing "EARTH (Ki)" is shown, with a smaller circle attached to it labeled "MOON (Kingu)". Curved lines with arrows show the paths of "COMETS" entering from the top right and "NORTH WIND" blowing from the left towards Earth. Below Earth, two dashed lines indicate "TIAMAT'S PATHS: ORIGINAL" (going straight down) and "AFTER COLLISION" (curving to the right). At the bottom left, a red "SUBSCRIBE" button is partially visible. At 0:02, a brown rectangular overlay appears over the diagram, with a prominent pink highlight covering the "ORBIT OF TWELFTH PLANET (Marduk)" and a section of the "ASTEROID BELT", while a male voice narrates details of a celestial collision involving Tiamat, Nibiru, Earth's moon, and the asteroid belt, referencing the "Enuma Elish".

The video opens with a dark blue webpage header featuring the NASA logo and text "NASA National Aeronautics and Space Administration" at the top left. Navigation links like "Home," "Planets," and "Missions" are visible. The main title of the page is "Hypothetical 'Planet X': Overview." A large pink number "1" partially obscures a video player in the center of the screen. At 0:01, the pink number disappears, revealing the full video player. A smaller thumbnail in the lower-left corner of the video player shows a man in a dark suit speaking. The main video window displays a dark blue planet against a starry black background. The title of this video is "Evidence of a Ninth Planet." Below the video, a textual description reads: "Caltech's Konstantin Batygin and Mike Brown discuss new research that provides evidence of a giant planet in the outer solar system." The bottom left corner of the screen continuously displays a red "SUBSCRIBE" button.

The video opens with a black background depicting a vast expanse of space. A bright, glowing white object, presumably the Sun, is centrally located. Several thin, purple elliptical lines orbit the central light, representing the paths of various celestial bodies. Small white dots, possibly stars, are scattered across the dark background. In the top right corner, the word "Caltech" is displayed in white text, and in the bottom left, the word "SUBSCRIBE" appears in red. At the 0:11 mark, yellow text reading "9TH PLANET" appears to the right of the central light, and a larger, yellow elliptical orbit, representing this 9th planet, forms around the Sun. The scene then transitions at 0:14 to show three spherical celestial bodies of varying sizes against the black background. From left to right, the first is a smaller, detailed sphere resembling Earth with blue oceans and white clouds. The second is a larger, light gray sphere labeled "9TH PLANET" in yellow text, with additional yellow text below it stating "1 to 10 times the mass of Earth." The third and largest sphere on the right is a vibrant blue planet, likely Neptune, with faint rings visible around it. The "Caltech" logo and the "SUBSCRIBE" text remain in their respective corners throughout this scene.

The video opens with an artist's concept of a dark blue-black planet, possibly Planet Nine, rotating slowly against a dark, starry background, with "Caltech" (English) at the top right and "Artist's Concept" (English) at the bottom right. A "SUBSCRIBE" (English) button in red is visible at the bottom left. The planet then fades, and the view zooms out to reveal a bright central star (the Sun) surrounded by concentric orbital paths. A yellow line extends from the Sun to an inner orbit labeled "EARTH" (English), with text indicating "Orbital period = 1 year" (English) and "93 million miles from the sun" (English). Subsequently, a larger, outer orbit is highlighted by another yellow line, identified as "JUPITER" (English), with "Orbital period = 12 years" (English) and "483 million miles from the sun" (English). Both yellow lines then disappear, and the scene further zooms out to show several more distant, slightly elliptical orbits, representing the Kuiper Belt, around the central star. Finally, the scene transitions to display a highly chaotic and intersecting set of several elliptical orbits in various colors (purple, white, yellow/gold), looping around the central bright star, illustrating the "unusual orbits" of certain Kuiper Belt objects. Throughout the video, "Caltech" (English) and "Artist's Concept" (English) remain visible at the top and bottom right corners, respectively.

The video opens with a celestial scene, featuring a dark background filled with countless shimmering white and colorful specks of light, reminiscent of stars and nebulae in deep space, which slowly shift and flow. In the bottom left corner, the word "SUBSCRIBE" is displayed in red text with a white outline. This transitions to a light blue screen where a white thumbs-up icon (like a Facebook "Like" button) appears, accompanied by the white text "DON'T FORGET TO LIKE THE VIDEO." This then changes to show the white text "AND DON'T FORGET TO SUBSCRIBE" on the same light blue background, which briefly darkens to a teal color with a slight glitch effect on the text. Following this, a solid teal screen appears with the white text "COME BACK FOR MORE...", where "MORE..." is highlighted in orange. The final scene reveals a warm, desert landscape at sunset or sunrise, with an orange and yellow sky, silhouetted mountains, and a bright sun or moon. A large, detailed bald eagle, primarily white-headed with brown and gold feathers, is prominently featured in the foreground, looking to the right. Two smaller, dark eagle silhouettes are seen flying in the sky. A red and white news bar appears at the bottom of the screen with the text "EAGLE NEWS." written in white.
